$comment: Client-bundle budgets, enforced by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs --check after `pnpm build` in CI; the script header describes the method. Numbers are KB gzip. routeBaselineKbGz is the measured first load of every page (the shared rootMainFiles plus the page's client-reference chunks, each file counted once by content hash), written with --write-baselines; a page fails when it is more than routeDriftAllowanceKbGz over its baseline, and a page without a baseline fails until one is written in the same change. firstLoadP95KbGz and firstLoadMaxKbGz cap the distribution across pages. uniqueClientKbGz caps the distinct client code: every module counted once by its module id, the lazy message catalogs excluded. maxCatalogKbGz holds each catalog, maxRechartsChunks the one shared chart chunk. The summed-chunk aggregate the gate used up to v1.44.0 (3875 KB there, capped at 3900) is still printed but no longer gated: it counted a module once per chunk group it landed in, so it rose whenever a page moved code into on-demand chunks and needed a raise in most releases while no reader downloaded more. Re-based at v1.45.0 from the v1.44.0 build, measured on a local arm64 machine: 110 pages, first load p50 336, p95 437, max 451 KB; unique client code 1904 KB in 1224 modules. The five pages watched before keep their numbers within a kilobyte (/ 359, /measurements 339, /insights/mood 337, /insights 323, /settings/[section] 311), and the metric pages that no watched route covered before are gated now too (/insights/weight 339, /insights/pulse 339). Caps: p95 447 and max 461 KB (10 KB over the measurement), unique client code 1930 KB (about 25 KB, roughly two releases of new client code). A raise or a re-base is a reviewed change with the measured numbers and the reason written here; earlier re-bases are in the history of this file.
